data.body: Fixed Gerrit 3017 patchset after reading both red gates. Blocking LLM findings confirmed against infra/terraform/monitoring_lmn_private_context.tf:148 (authoritative aws_s3_bucket_notification on adopted log bucket) and :160 (CloudWatch alarm had no alarm_actions/ok_actions). Verified -1 reproduced locally with tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py::{test_every_alarm_declares_alarm_actions,test_every_alarm_declares_ok_actions}. Root fix replaces S3 bucket notification with the existing EventBridge scheduled Lambda pattern, adds scheduled scanning tests for recent delivered access logs, and wires alarm_actions/ok_actions plus datapoints_to_alarm. Focused tests pass (5/5). Full make verify completed with only the known macOS arm64 pandoc failures: 17 wiki-render/reconciler tests fail due OSError [Errno 86] Bad CPU type in executable for pypandoc/files/pandoc; 20,296 passed, 126 skipped. Amended commit: 204c60697b8d2468e35f3168ae008c63c87e780f. Not pushed.
